author: villomaru
quote: Buggy, overhyped mess that can't even hit 30 FPS. The nepobaby of the gaming industry.

author: villomaru
quote: The biggest changes that don't loop back to presentation are the ability to sprint and manual jumping, so it really speaks to how incredibly well the original game holds up when a 98% faithful remake is one of the best things I have ever played. Ocarina of Time isn't my favorite Zelda game but it is deserving of being called the greatest game of all time, and this remake arrives to reclaim its crown.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
